title: Lionel Messi’s Final Match: Here’s Where to Livestream the Argentina vs. Benin Soccer Game Online Free
summary: After a decorated international career spanning more than 20 years, the soccer legend makes his final appearance for Argentina this week.
contentText:

Lionel Messi takes to the soccer pitch Tuesday for the final time as captain of the Argentinian men’s national football team.

After a decorated international career spanning more than 20 years, Messi makes his final appearance for Argentina, as La Albiceleste take on Benin in an international friendly that also marks the soccer star’s retirement match.

How to Watch Messi Final Match, at a Glance:

- Date: Tuesday, Oct. 6

- Time: 8 p.m. local time (7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT)

- Network: ViX (U.S.), Premier Sports (UK), L’Équipe (France), ZEE5 (India)

- Online Streaming: ViX Premium (free trial), ExpressVPN

Billed as “The Last Tango,” the Argentina vs. Benin match takes place Oct. 6, live from Monumental Stadium in Buenos Aires. Kickoff is at 8 p.m. local time (7 p.m. ET).

Messi’s final match isn’t being broadcast on traditional TV here in the U.S., but viewers can find an Argentina vs. Benin livestream on ViX Premium , the popular Spanish-language streaming service.

Messi is Argentina’s all-time leader in caps and goals scored, and he memorably led the team to the 2022 World Cup win in Qatar. Messi and co. just missed a repeat at this year’s World Cup, falling to Spain in the 2026 final .

Officials say all 85,000 seats at Monumental Stadium have been sold, with thousands of other fans expected to pack the surrounding streets for a chance to bid farewell to the sporting legend. Messi jerseys are also selling out online, as he makes his final appearance in the country’s blue and white stripes.

As for La Albiceleste, Messi will be replaced by 28-year-old Cristian “Cuti” Romero as the new captain for the Argentinian squad.
